workItem: P8.62.R Graph Delta Approval Workbench Review Access Helper
purpose: Make the P8.62 user-observed review easier to run.
Avoid relying on file:// opening when a local HTTP route is easier for browsers.
Keep the review gate explicit: only the coordinator can answer accept, revise, or blocked.
usage: Open http://127.0.0.1:8762/index.html if the browser does not open automatically.
Reply with accept, revise, or blocked.
recommendedNextAction: Run the helper locally and wait for the coordinator review response.
